name: World time facts
notes: The minimum world day clock (mw-ju8.6), until the real in-game clock lands (mw-e27.12). It never advances with sim ticks: only resting at an inn moves it (to 06:00 the next morning). mw-e27.12 takes these keys over.

facts.description: The in-world day number, 1 on the first day. Increases each time the player sleeps through a midnight (rest at an inn).
The minute of the in-world day, 0-1439 (480 = 08:00, a new world's start). Resting at an inn sets it to 360 (06:00).
